card.name: The word from after may benefit
card.fires_on: The word "from" right after "may benefit" in a sentence about complex patients with pain and substance use disorders being referred to a specialist.

modes.label: benefit from referral
modes.description: "from" follows "may benefit" just before "referral to a specialist" in opioid treatment guidance.
modes.example: Complex patients with co-morbid pain and substance use disorders may benefit<< from>> referral to a specialist.

card.plain: It fires on the word "from" in the phrase "may benefit from referral to a specialist" in opioid treatment guidance.
